settings.language.hint: The language of the interface. Until you choose one, it follows the Windows language.
settings.fontFamily.hint: Applies to terminals and the file view. Separate several fonts with commas; the first one installed is used.
settings.fontSize.hint: In pixels, from {min} to {max}. Applies to terminals and the file view.
settings.defaultShell.hint: The shell a new terminal starts with.
settings.agentCommand.hint: The command “New Agent” uses to start Claude Code. You can add options, for example “claude --continue”.
sidebar.notAvailable: This view arrives in a later step.
welcome.text: Open a folder as a project to get started.

window.title: {project} — Kredr
terminal.closeConfirm.title: Close terminal?

agent.name: Agent

file.tooLarge: “{name}” is {size} MB and too large for the file view.
file.conflict: “{name}” was changed on disk while you have unsaved changes.
